title: Check Before You Share
description: Always verify the source and context of information before sharing it online.

title: Beware of Sensational Headlines
description: Headlines designed to create shock or fear may not provide the complete context.

title: Check the Date
description: Old photographs and news stories can sometimes be shared as if they are recent.

title: Verify the Original Source
description: Look for the original publisher and compare important claims with reliable sources.

title: Do Not Trust Every Forwarded Message
description: Messages received through social media or messaging apps should be checked before forwarding.

title: Images Can Be Misleading
description: An image may be old, edited or presented without its original context.
